mentions.name: Portable AQI meter
mentions.description: Portable air quality meter built into a small 3D-printed box containing a Raspberry Pi Pico, 18650 battery, e-ink display, and SEN66 sensor. Pressing a button runs the sensor for about 40 seconds to get a good reading, shows AQI, temperature, and CO2 on the e-ink display, then powers off with zero standby power draw, letting the battery last roughly 1500 readings; readings match the builder's permanently placed indoor and outdoor sensors.
mentions.problem: Air quality in Central Oregon can quickly get bad.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Most recently I made a portable AQI meter, since the air quality here in Central Oregon can quickly get bad.

It's a small 3d printed box containing a rpi pico, an 18650 battery, an e-ink display, and a SEN66 sensor.
